feature_consistency: Complete inputs use exact frozen161features; wave feature columns and site ID remain byte-exact under every weather mask. Weather rolling statistics use available values in the original newest-to-oldest summation order. Differences use only observed endpoints.
threshold_consistency: Use previously archived training95th percentile thresholds in prepared/*.json; avoid changes due only to float32quantile output rounding.
mask_cache: Unchanged deterministic nonrandom adapter masks reuse aligned archived forecasts; random30 is replayed on CPU using the common stored mask. No model or hyperparameter selection uses evaluation diagnostics.
pdf_mapping: WPS truncates non-BMP mathematical Unicode to a high surrogate in ToUnicode; repair from embedded-font cmap using identity CIDToGID. Pixel-identical check and zero replacement characters required.
